needs: Mr and Mrs Coetzee (a joint investment, held under Johannes Coetzee) are both around fifty and still working. No income is required at this stage — this is growth capital of approximately R4.5 million. They are experienced investors comfortable with a moderate-to-aggressive risk profile, with a long horizon of ten years or more before drawdown. They want a meaningful offshore allocation given concerns about rand depreciation.

objective.riskProfile: Moderate-to-aggressive. Experienced investors comfortable with short-term volatility in pursuit of inflation-beating growth over a ten-year-plus horizon, with a meaningful offshore allocation to hedge rand risk.
